text: Payments over 500,000 need the Head of Finance's approval
Changed bank details need a call-back on a known number before payment
Keep a 250,000 USD cash buffer per entity
No single name above 5 percent of the liquid portfolio
Daily cash may differ by up to 5,000 per entity before it is a break
The sovereign note Harbour Treasury Note 2029 is exempt from the 5 percent single-name limit of the liquid book (EG-LIQUID): a government issuer is not a single-name exposure
The liquid book (EG-LIQUID) is measured against the EG-OFFICE-BLEND benchmark
An invoice above its fee schedule is held from the payment run until the vendor corrects it
Proposed by Tom Hale at the 17 June committee, not yet signed: EG-LIQUID: any single name 0% to 6% of the portfolio, measured at the month end
